I'm applying for the Marketing Lead role. Your approach to continuous website optimization and taking on legacy testing tools immediately caught my attention. I've been following Dalton's early traction and would love to help turn that momentum into a movement.

In my current role at Episto, I handle SEO, content, and WordPress builds for client sites. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Dalton's growth.

cover_letter:
Dear Dalton team,

I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Lead position. Dalton's mission to make websites optimize themselves—and to challenge the legacy A/B testing status quo—resonates with me deeply. I've been following your progress since launch and am excited by the opportunity to build your marketing engine from the ground up.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites for clients. I also handle social media coordination and performance reporting. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has taught me how to execute across multiple channels and iterate quickly based on data.

While I'm early in my career, I'm execution-focused and eager to take on new challenges. I'm comfortable creating content, managing paid campaigns, and analyzing performance. I'm particularly excited about the opportunity to record videos, run webinars, and manage conference presence—areas where I can grow with Dalton's support. My technical background in web design and SEO gives me a solid foundation to understand and communicate your product's value.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just next to Antwerp, and can easily work from Wintercircus in Ghent. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving. I'd love the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Dalton's growth and help build a brand people pay attention to.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
